The following events took place in '''50 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Unidentified Galladinium president|Galladinium]] founds [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] on [[Lenthalis]].
*[[Kinnin Vo-Shay]] disappears into a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] in the [[Tyus Cluster/Legends|Tyus Cluster]], and comes out [[0 BBY/Legends|fifty years later]] on the other side.
*The [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] is incorporated into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] with [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] as its [[Sector/Legends|sector]] capital.<ref name="GORW" />
*[[Salt/Legends|Salt]] is introduced to the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]].
*Young [[Anomid/Legends|Anomids]] develop a nonconformist subculture.
*[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] scouts discover [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]] and the [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
*The Galactic Republic first makes contact with the [[Elom/Legends|Elom]].
*The [[Arkanian Renegades]] attempt to overthrow their planet's [[Arkanian Dominion|government]] in the [[Arkanian Revolution]].
*c. 50 BBY [[Mammon Hoole]] visits his [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] friend [[Karke]] on [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]].<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

==Battles==
*[[Arkanian Revolution]], fought over the re-engineering of the [[Yaka]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
